en: I'm humbled. I lost this bout, fair and square.
The victory is mine. Now, try not to lose heart.
You should put more effort into your training.
Use this chance to throw yourself into training.
Young lord, your attacks are too soft.
Young lord, with skill like that you are not fit for war.
note: [edit: 'cannot go to war' read as a ban; now unfit for war]

en: With skill like that, you'll never shine in battle.
With skill that poor, the sword at your hip must weep.
Weak, weak! A swordsman, with that skill? What a joke!
All talk, I see. Come back when you're ready.
You've a long way to go. Use this to spur yourself on.
How feeble... I shall train you myself.
You're weak. And you call yourself a ninja?
You want to take me on? Come back in ten years!
The win is mine. Come back when you're stronger.
How can one so weak be a kunoichi? Come back when ready.
Don't blame yourself... You were simply outmatched.
I'll take you on again anytime.
When you're able to beat me, I'll take you on again.
In battle, one careless moment like that means death!
I had thought you would be stronger. How disappointing.
To prepare for war, daily training is a must, I'd say...
At this rate, His Lordship will laugh at you!
To think I beat one so strong! I'll brag to everyone.
I thought you were strong, but it was all for show.
So you only looked strong, did you?
For a ninja, you were full of openings.
Weak. Is this one really a ninja?
Heh. I can't afford to lose that easily.
All bark and no bite. You're no match for me.
Hehehe... I can't let myself lose that easily, you know.
Heh, you caught on too late. You're no match for me.
I've wasted my time again.
Seems you need more training. Come back when you're ready.

en:

After Nobunaga escorts Yoshiaki into Kyoto, Mitsuhide becomes an Oda retainer at Nobunaga's wish. (Ep. 19)
